craft_notes: Sthāyin: withhold-joy. Close: release. Rejected: 'instant' — 'at once' kept (sadyaḥ).

lines: Not yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this prize —
the heart of gods' own God, where swift yoga-release lies.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam |

reads_against.argmap: This not yoginī-born, not Rudra gets plainly — heart of god of gods, at once yoga-release-giving.
c1_essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
